title: Your steer: same feel, higher end
question: This keeps the old site's world and lifts every detail to luxury level. Confirm, or steer again.

options.label: The Old Feel, Elevated
options.lineage: The current Beams & Braces world: bog oak, oiled brass, Fraunces and Plus Jakarta Sans
options.thesis: Same dark-and-brass warmth and the same serif voice, executed like a luxury house: more space, bigger photography, fewer UI gadgets, brass used like jewellery.
materials: light Fraunces display with brass italic accents
brass hairlines, square-cut buttons, no pills or badges
options.viewport: A full-screen real deck photograph under a slow, deep bog-oak fade. The headline sits large and light in Fraunces with one brass italic word, next to Let's Chat and WhatsApp. The credentials run as one quiet brass-ruled line at the foot of the image.
options.risk: Luxury restraint can read as thin if the photography isn't strong. The real photos have to carry it.
